description: Draw the same small chart once per group (country, product, team) in a grid, all on one shared scale, so the groups can be compared at a glance. Rows are {group, x, value}, e.g. {group:'France', x:'Jan', value:120}. Up to 24 groups. For a few groups on one chart use generate_line_chart with group. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

columns.description: Charts per row in the grid (chosen automatically when left out).

data.description: One row per group and x value; each group gets its own small chart.

name: generate_small_multiples
title: Small multiples
